scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: Funny faces game! Big eyes, silly nose, giant smile… Nico always wins this game.
scene.intro: Funny faces game! Freya makes big round eyes, a small nose and an enormous smile. Then Nico tries: he has got one eye open, one eye closed and his teeth outside. He always wins this game! She has got a nice smile, he has got a very silly one. Look at your friend's face: what has he got? What has she got? Make a funny face and play with Freya and Nico!

words.clue: You see with them. You have two.
You smell with it. It is in the middle.
You eat and talk with it.

activities.title: Match the face part with what it does.
Listen. Who is it? Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Freya: Guess who! She has got long yellow hair. … Nico: That's you, Freya! … Freya: Yes! Now: he has got short black hair and a big smile. … Nico: That's me! I love this game. … Freya: This one has got two black eyes and an orange nose… … Nico: Wait… feathers? That's Pip! … Freya: Last one: she has got brown hair and she is very tidy. … Nico: Astrid! Four out of four!

activities.title: Quick check · Choose the correct word.

data.text: Draw a funny face (big nose? three eyes?). Describe it: "It has got…" Your partner draws what they hear. Compare!

activities.title: Look at A and B. What is different?
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Draw a family member's face and write 3 sentences: He/She has got…

outcomes.puede: Follow classroom instructions; identify familiar words in songs and short spoken sentences.
Greet; say name, age, colours; name objects; answer yes/no questions.
Recognise all 26 letters; match words to pictures (family, food, animals, body).
Write own name; trace and copy words; label pictures (3–5 words).
~150 productive words; Verb to be, can, like + noun, imperatives, this/that.
